name: AWS API MCP Server
upstream_status_note: The README says the server is superseded by another AWS MCP server and that a deprecation notice is shown at start-up; releases continued (1.6.0 on 2026-10-27). Quoted: “This MCP server is superseded by the official [AWS MCP server]”.
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C4, C6, C8, C9, C10; partly meets C3, C5, C7.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The PyPI record for awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server 1.6.0 links the repository, and PyPI holds a provenance attestation for the release naming `awslabs/mcp` (workflow `release.yml`) as publisher.

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository, and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and releases continue, but the README says the server is superseded by a successor and describes a deprecation notice shown at start-up. Quoted: “This MCP server is superseded by the official [AWS MCP server]”; “suppresses the deprecation notice that is otherwise shown at server startup”. Latest release 1.6.0 is dated 2026-10-27; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-13; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-13.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: 4 advisories are published in the repository's advisory list for awslabs.aws-api-mcp-server; each names a patched version at or below the latest release (1.6.0). Most recent: GHSA-4wq9-grf3-qg2p (high, published 2026-11-10, patched in 1.5.1).

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: Mutating AWS operations are available by default; the README documents a read-only switch that is off by default. Quoted: “`READ_OPERATIONS_ONLY` | ❌ No | `"false"` | When set to "true", restricts execution to read-only operations only.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: Credentials come from the AWS credential chain, a named profile or environment variables. Quoted: “Use environment variables to configure AWS credentials”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: Additional telemetry to AWS is documented as on by default, with an environment variable to turn it off. Quoted: “`AWS_API_MCP_TELEMETRY` | ❌ No | `"true"` | Allow sending additional telemetry data to AWS related to the server configuration.”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`src/aws-api-mcp-server/uv.lock`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README has a section on prompt injection and untrusted data with recommendations. Quoted: “**Do not connect this MCP server to data sources with untrusted data**”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: fastmcp<4.0,>=3.4.3 (also mcp<2.0,>=1.23.0). Lower-bound version 3.4.3 of fastmcp (PyPI) was published on 2026-07-05, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
